name: ideabox
description: Dev-time dependency pinning for the front-end libraries bundled by the ideabox GLPI plugin.

scripts.build:fuse: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),s='node_modules/fuse.js/dist/fuse.min.js',d='public/lib/fuse.min.js',n=p=>fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split('\r').join('');if(!fs.existsSync(d)||n(s)!==n(d)){fs.copyFileSync(s,d);console.log('fuse.min.js: synced from fuse.js dist')}else{console.log('fuse.min.js: already in sync, skipping copy')}"
